entities.summary: Hubert von Luschka, born Hubert Luschka, was a German anatomist. He lent his name to several structures, including the foramina of Luschka, Luschka's crypts, Luschka's joints, and Ducts of Luschka. His name is also associated with Luschka's law, an anatomical rule concerning location of the ureters. Hubert von Luschka was a naturalists & biologists from Constance (1820-07-27, Constance–1875-03-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
